purpose: Exploratory same-state comparison on our signed future-xG task, not a product superiority test
model_policy: Reuse frozen three-seed GNN, ball and no-message ensembles; no retraining or test-based tuning
xg_source: Existing StatsBomb goal-trained geometry model; not provider StatsBomb xG
target: signed first shot xG in (t,t+15s], same period, full horizon required, including interruptions
sampling: Exact player-possession start frame; start matched; tracking possession team agrees with event team; provider for and against values present; unique event per period/frame
provider_net: for minus against; possession_epv_total is not a state value
adaptation: Unregularized affine least squares fitted only on the existing three validation matches; provider uses both for and against components; net-only affine and GNN affine also reported
metric: pooled snapshot MSE/RMSE with paired whole-match descriptive bootstrap
evaluation_status: Existing three test matches were previously evaluated; this is an exploratory extension, not a new untouched test
provider_limitations: Unknown provider training overlap and exact open-data model version; current product describes a different horizon and goal target
